description.value: Kwantlen Outdoor Pool is a seasonal municipal outdoor swimming pool operated by the City of Surrey, located in the Whalley neighbourhood next to Kwantlen Park Secondary School. It is easily accessible on 104 Avenue from King George Boulevard, making it a convenient summer cool-down stop for cyclists passing through Surrey.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a City of Surrey seasonal outdoor pool at 13035 - 104 Avenue, Surrey, BC V3T 1T8, opening June 27, 2026. Phone on the website (604-502-6252) matches the OSM tag. The OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but the facility is clearly in Surrey (Whalley), which is a data error. No explicit mention of bike parking, washrooms, showers, or water refill on the website, so those are null despite being likely for a pool facility.
